title: SITA OS
shortDescription: Sovereign AI operating system. Calm intelligence, every day.
fullDescription:
SITA OS is a premium, dark-first AI operating system for owner-operators, founders, and family principals.

It turns scattered work, money, and life signals into a calm, advised flow:

• Boardroom — strategic council that reviews your operating reality
• Business — pipeline, accounts, and outcomes in one dignified workspace
• Money — reserves, runway, and tax posture explained in plain language
• Concierge — 24/7 advisor presence across every surface
• Files — encrypted vault with semantic search and proof-grade AI summaries

Designed for calm, not noise. End-to-end encryption. No ads. No data resale. Your sovereign operating layer.
